title.note: Game title kept byte-identical (glossary: keep); Swedish players see English Roblox titles.

hud.reel.note: "Veva in" (crank the reel in) is the everyday Swedish angling verb; same verb as the pass name Autoveva. "Dra in" (6) is the plainer fallback.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form so 0, 1 and 12 all read correctly.

catch.success.note: "New catch: X (tier)!" -- a label form, so no article or adjective has to agree with an unseen fish name (en/ett) and the tier stays in its tag form.

catch.escaped.note: "slita sig" is the Swedish angling idiom for a fish breaking off the hook; "It" becomes the generic "Fisken".

catch.new_record.note: Developer: {weight} arrives as "12.4"; Swedish writes "12,4". Format by LocaleId if possible.

fish.lantern_eel.note: lykta (lantern) + ål (eel), compounded like "lyktstolpe"; keeps the glowing-lantern idea. "Lanternål" is the alternative.

shop.rods.note: "Fiskespön" rather than bare "Spön" so it cannot read as sticks or canes; 9/10.

shop.equipped.note: "In use": avoids agreeing a participle with the neuter noun spö ("utrustat"), and is the usual Swedish UI state label.

pass.auto_reel.note: auto + veva, built like "autospara"; same verb as hud.reel "Veva in". Store name in Creator Hub should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Turbete fördubblar chansen att fånga sällsynta fiskar!
pass.lucky_bait.note: Turbete = tur (luck) + bete (bait), patterned on Minecraft's "Turbrygd". Possessive "your" dropped as Swedish does.

sell.done.note: "fisk" has plural "fiskar", so "{count} fiskar" breaks at 1; label form for count. "mynt" is invariant, so {coins} is safe. 30/40.

sell.prompt.note: Short spoken form "Tryck E" (guide); "Tryck på E" would be 24/21. Exactly 21/21. Source-side: phone and console players have no E key; ActionText "Sälj" would serve everyone.

ascend.button.note: Prestige verb: "advance", neither religious nor climbing ("Stig upp" would be both). Same word in ascend.confirm.
ascend.button.blind_remark: means advance or move up; on its own it does not suggest a reset or prestige

ascend.confirm.text: Vill du avancera nu? Du börjar om från början, men du fångar sällsynta fiskar {bonus} % oftare.
ascend.confirm.note: Full question for a decision (guide); space before % is the Swedish norm.

weather.storm.text: En storm är på väg! Sällsynta fiskar nappar.
weather.storm.note: "nappa" is the Swedish verb for fish taking the bait.

quest.catch_n.note: "Fånga {n} fiskar" breaks at n = 1, so mass noun "fisk" plus a count label. "i" (in the bay) is the natural preposition for fishing a bay. 28/40.

quest.claim.blind_remark: literally 'fetch'; with no object it is also the usual word for 'Get' or 'Download'

friends.boost.note: Statement with the noun "Fiske" (fishing); space before % per Swedish convention.

trade.accept.note: "ditt byte" alone could read as "your prey" in a fishing game, so "bytesförfrågan" (trade request), matching trade.sent. 28/33.

codes.redeemed.text: Koden är inlöst! Njut av belöningen.

afk.kicked.text: Du var inaktiv för länge, så fisket stoppades.
afk.kicked.note: "so your fishing was stopped": "slutade fiska" would sound like the player chose to stop.

settings.back.note: Standard Swedish Back button; exactly 8/8. "Bakåt" (5) if it clips.

event.ends.note: "om" for a point ahead. {time} as "2d 4h" matches CLDR's narrow Swedish units, so it reads fine.

daily.streak.text: Dagar i rad: {day}! Kom tillbaka i morgon för fler belöningar.
daily.streak.note: "Days in a row: {day}!" label form, since "{day} dagar i rad" breaks at 1. "for more" made explicit as "fler belöningar" (more rewards). 57/62.

tip.night.text: Tips: vissa fiskar nappar bara på natten.

group.join.text: Gå med i gruppen och få 50 beten gratis!
group.join.note: "beten" is the plural of "ett bete"; native check that 50 counted baits reads naturally. "Gå med i" and "grupp" as Roblox's Swedish listing.

leaderboard.biggest.note: "Heaviest catch": the board ranks by weight, and "tyngsta" says so. "Största fångsten" (16) also works.
